messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: includeHTML doesn't work
parts:
It should work fine if you include the file from the same directory as the app.R (or ui.R and server.R). See this example:
  http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/including-html-text-and-markdown-files.html

The source is here:
  https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/tree/master/048-including-html-text-and-markdown-files

If you still have trouble with it, it would help if you could post a reproducible example.

-Winston
